description: Live surf cams for a town or one of its surf spots: free cams (e.g. MEO Beachcam and Surftotal in Portugal, Viewsurf and GoSurf in France, Beach Cam Israel, WaveHub and GoSurf Israel, council, surf-school and YouTube live cams) and premium ones (Surfline), each with when it was last checked, whether it was up, when a browser last saw it play a real picture (verifiedPlaying) and whether it is video (live: true) or still pictures (live: false), and embed: how Swell Cabin shows it on its own pages where the operator allows that (kind youtube: the YouTube player URL; kind still: the SkylineWebcams picture that updates every 5 minutes, from the still API; kind player: the operator's own player, which the operator agreed Swell Cabin may show, with the date they agreed (permission); null: a link only, e.g. MEO Beachcam, whose terms keep the stream its own); pinNote explains where a network pins the cam in the wrong place. `networks` are the local cam networks that cover the town (worth checking for spots without a saved cam). Only cams Swell Cabin opened and checked are listed (Surfline last); no search links. For spots without a saved cam, `search` lists the checked networks that cover the town.

spot.description: Optional: one surf spot name, as returned by get_town or find_surf_spots.
